request.lyrics:

My soul waits in silence for God alone
From Him comes my salvation
He is my rock and my salvation
My stronghold in this world

[Chorus]
I will never be badly shaken
My soul waits in silence
From Him comes my salvation
My soul waits in silence

[Verse]

Like a leaning wall tottering
Like a fence that cannot stand
You plot to bring him down

[Chorus]
I will never be badly shaken
My soul waits in silence
From Him comes my salvation
My soul waits in silence

[Bridge]
They take pleasure in falsehood

Inwardly they curse
My soul rests in truth

[Outro]
For He alone is my rock
My salvation my stronghold
My soul waits in silence
